slides.copy: The rugged landscape of the newest U.S. national park rises steeply above the surrounding desert.
slides.altText: An oblique aerial view of Chiricahua National Park.

slides.copy: A paved road winds its way through Bonita Canyon, a popular area for hiking and birdwatching.
slides.altText: A zoomed in view of the rugged standing rocks of Bonita Canyon.

slides.copy: The park is an excellent area for birdwatching, with over 200 documented species.
slides.altText: An oblique aerial view of Chiricahua National Park.
